result.overallRead: The resume shows a mid-level product marketing professional with consistent roles but is underspecified for impact and for the clinical research role you're asking about. It has the expected sections, but bullets are duties-only, lack measurable outcomes, and do not match the clinical monitoring requirements in the job description.

dimensionNotes.note: All expected sections (Contact, Experience, Education, Skills) are present.
Most bullets list responsibilities without measurable outcomes; mid-level candidates must quantify impact.
Extracted text appears coherent and not scrambled; no parsing artifacts observed.
Many bullets open with weak or passive phrases ('Responsible for', 'Worked on', 'Helped'); stronger verbs would improve skim readability.
Recent role has several short, undifferentiated bullets; space does not communicate ownership or scope clearly.
Resume does not surface the clinical-monitoring skills or credentials the job requires; most job requirements are absent.

findings.originalText: Responsible for product launch communications across the EMEA region.
findings.suggestedText: Led product launch communications across the EMEA region, achieving [X outcome or metric].
findings.reason: Mid-level candidates must show what their work changed; a responsibility-only bullet reads junior and costs interviews.
Job requires 5+ years of clinical monitoring experience; resume shows 4 years in product marketing and no clinical monitoring — this is a hard mismatch that will prevent a pass on surface review.
Job requires a degree in life sciences, nursing, or related discipline; the candidate's degrees are in Marketing Management and Economics, so the educational requirement is unmet.
Job asks for detailed working knowledge of ICH-GCP and regulatory frameworks; resume contains no mention of ICH-GCP training or regulatory experience.
Job expects experience authoring monitoring visit reports and managing site escalations; resume has no monitoring/reporting or escalation management evidence.
Job requires willingness to travel up to 60% and a valid driving licence; the resume does not state travel availability or licence status.

findings.originalText: Worked on positioning and messaging for two product lines.
findings.suggestedText: Developed positioning and messaging for two product lines to support [target audience or objective].
findings.reason: Opening with 'Worked on' is weak; a specific active verb shows ownership and reads stronger to a quick scanner.

findings.originalText: Helped with sales enablement materials and competitive briefs.
findings.suggestedText: Created sales enablement materials and competitive briefs used by [team size or audience].
findings.reason: 'Helped with' understates contribution; use a precise verb that says what you actually did.
Recent role bullets are short and duty-focused; expand 2–3 bullets with scope (projects owned), stakeholders, and measurable outcomes to signal seniority.
No parsing errors seen in the extracted text, but keep formatting simple (no tables or icons) to ensure ATS safety.

recruiterScan.whatLandsFirst: Name, location (Milan), summary 'Product marketing professional with 4 years of experience in B2B software.'
recruiterScan.whatIsMissingUpTop: Any clinical or life-sciences signals (GCP, monitoring, oncology), and quantified impact or ownership statements.
recruiterScan.fifteenSecondVerdict: This is a mid-level product marketer; not a match for a Senior Clinical Research Associate role — lacks clinical experience, relevant degree, regulatory/GCP evidence, and monitoring experience.
worksWell: Clear job titles and dates for two consecutive roles at the same company.
Skills section lists relevant marketing tools and languages.
worksAgainst: Bullets are duty-focused and lack outcomes.
No clinical, regulatory, or monitoring keywords evident for the applied role.
Education is unrelated to life sciences requirement.

requirementCoverage.requirement: 5+ years of clinical monitoring experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical sponsor.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: No clinical monitoring or CRO/pharma monitoring roles listed; experience is in product marketing ('Product Marketing Manager', 'Marketing Associate').
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If you have relevant clinical monitoring experience, add exact role(s), employer, dates, and  quantified examples; if not, do not claim this experience — consider applying to roles aligned with product marketing.

requirementCoverage.requirement: Degree in life sciences, nursing, or a related discipline.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: Degrees listed: MSc Marketing Management; BA Economics.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If you hold any relevant certifications or coursework in life sciences, list them clearly; otherwise this requirement is unmet and will block candidacy for this job.

requirementCoverage.requirement: Detailed working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory frameworks.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: No mention of ICH-GCP, GCP training, or regulatory experience in skills or bullets.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If trained or certified in ICH-GCP, add the certificate name and date; if you have applied regulatory frameworks, add a bullet describing the work and context.

requirementCoverage.requirement: Experience authoring monitoring visit reports and managing site escalations.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: No monitoring visit report, site escalation, or similar terminology appears in the resume.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: Add specific bullets showing report authorship, examples of escalations handled, and who you coordinated with, including any metrics (number of sites, time to resolution).

requirementCoverage.requirement: Willingness to travel to investigator sites up to 60% of the time.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: No travel availability or preferences stated.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If willing to travel, state 'willing to travel up to 60%' in summary or contact section; include driving licence status if required.
Add 'Valid driving licence' to Contact or Skills if you have one.

requirementCoverage.requirement: Nice to have: Oncology therapeutic area experience.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: No therapeutic area or oncology experience noted.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If you have oncology or related experience, add it with details; otherwise accept this as not met.

requirementCoverage.requirement: Nice to have: Experience with electronic data capture systems such as Medidata Rave.
requirementCoverage.evidenceInResume: Skills list includes HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics — no EDC systems listed.
requirementCoverage.howToAddress: If you have EDC experience, add tool names and context; do not claim tools you haven't used.
